correctness.rationale: The natural-gap construction gives the stated endpoints in D_q, including the split after (2) for q=2. At q=2 the tail product telescopes to 2m/(m+1); expanding the remaining double sum gives 4 zeta(3)-2. For q>=3, put t=2^(-q) and c=(zeta(2)-1)/zeta(2)>3/8. The gap ratio is at least 1+ct/(1-t), while A_(q+2) <= (1-3t/8)^(-1). In the other direction, the normalized zeta(2) tail W_n has n W_n <= 2c < 26/33, and S_q=sum_(n>=2) n^(-q) < 7/33. Expanding each finite product gives F_m-1 <= sum_(2<=n<=m) n^(-q)/(1-S_q); summing against m^-2 and switching the nonnegative sums bounds the ratio minus one strictly below S_(q+1) <= A_(q+1)-1. The separate rational chain 48/43 < 8/7 < R_2/L_2 < 108/91 supplies the needed q=2 bounds. Monotonicity of A_p and the verified endpoint membership yield precisely the claimed nonempty omitted interval for p>=q+2. For p<=q+1 only this diameter obstruction disappears; no assertion about residual gaps follows. The packaged finite rational/numerical checks were inspected as corroboration, not run or used for the universal proof.
